import json
import platform
import packaging.specifiers
from packaging.specifiers import Specifier

cases = [
    ('valid_noop', '>=1', {}),
    ('valid_change', '==1', {'operator': '>', 'version': '2', 'prereleases': False}),
    ('split_operator_version', '==1', {'operator': '>', 'version': '=2'}),
    ('operator_contains_version', '>=1', {'operator': '>=2'}),
    ('invalid_prereleases', '==1', {'prereleases': 'yes'}),
    ('numeric_version', '==1', {'version': 2}),
]
results = {}
for name, text, changes in cases:
    original = Specifier(text)
    before = (str(original), original._prereleases)
    try:
        result = original.__replace__(**changes)
        observation = dict(outcome='accepted', text=str(result), operator=result.operator,
                           version=result.version, prereleases=result.prereleases,
                           prereleases_override=result._prereleases, same=result is original)
    except Exception as exc:
        observation = dict(outcome='exception', exception=type(exc).__name__, message=str(exc))
    observation['original_unchanged'] = before == (str(original), original._prereleases)
    results[name] = dict(input=text, changes=changes, observation=observation)
print(json.dumps(dict(python=platform.python_version(), module=packaging.specifiers.__file__, cases=results), indent=2))
